name: egl-19(n2368) — 900 s Agar Plate
description: Real egl-19(n2368) C. elegans recording, 900 s on agar (Zenodo 1030607, Open Worm Movement Database 2010). egl-19 encodes the voltage-gated Ca²⁺ channel Caᵥ1.2; the partial loss-of-function allele n2368 reduces muscle Ca²⁺ influx, causing lower body-wave amplitude and reduced undulation frequency. Left: raw WCON skeleton (head=index 0), 1 tracker-swap flip corrected at t=137.3 s by optimal_head_tail_flips. Right: NeuromuscularTuner 4-mode PCA eigenworm reconstruction (mu(s) + Σ aₙ(t)·eₙ(s), n=1..4). The first segment (t=0–137 s, var_exp=0.52) reflects genuinely irregular egl-19 posture; post-correction segment (t=140–898 s, var_exp=0.82) confirms consistent eigenworm basis.
